en.bdb: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verse.unicode: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਖਾਇਆ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸੋਇਆ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਅੰਗਿ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥

transliteration.english: dhirag dhirag khaiaa dhirag dhirag soiaa dhirag dhirag kaapaR a(n)g chaRaiaa ||

en.bdb: Cursed, cursed is the food; cursed, cursed is the sleep; cursed, cursed are the clothes worn on the body.

verse.unicode: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਹਿਤ ਸਿਉ ਜਿਤੁ ਹੁਣਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥

transliteration.english: dhirag sareer kuTa(n)b sahit siau jit hun khasam na paiaa ||

en.bdb: Cursed is the body, along with family and friends, when one does not find his Lord and Master in this life.

verse.unicode: ਪਉੜੀ ਛੁੜਕੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: pauRee chhuRakee fir haath na aavai ahilaa janam gavaiaa ||1||

en.bdb: He misses the step of the ladder, and this opportunity will not come into his hands again; his life is wasted, uselessly. ||1||

verse.unicode: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਣਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥

transliteration.english: dhoojaa bhaau na dheiee liv laagan jin har ke charan visaare ||

en.bdb: The love of duality does not allow him to lovingly focus his attention on the Lord; he forgets the Feet of the Lord.

verse.unicode: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਤੇਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਤੈ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

transliteration.english: jagajeevan dhaataa jan sevak tere tin ke tai dhookh nivaare ||1|| rahaau ||

en.bdb: O Life of the World, O Great Giver, you eradicate the sorrows of your humble servants. ||1||Pause||

verse.unicode: ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਏਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥

transliteration.english: too dhiaal dhiaapat dhaataa kiaa eh ja(n)t vichaare ||

en.bdb: You are Merciful, O Great Giver of Mercy; what are these poor beings?

verse.unicode: ਮੁਕਤ ਬੰਧ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਏ ਐਸਾ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥

transliteration.english: mukat ba(n)dh sabh tujh te hoe aaisaa aakh vakhaane ||

en.bdb: All are liberated or placed into bondage by You; this is all one can say.

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੰਧ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥੨॥

transliteration.english: gurmukh hovai so mukat kaheeaai manmukh ba(n)dh vichaare ||2||

en.bdb: One who becomes Gurmukh is said to be liberated, while the poor self-willed manmukhs are in bondage. ||2||

verse.unicode: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥

transliteration.english: so jan mukat jis ek liv laagee sadhaa rahai har naale ||

en.bdb: He alone is liberated, who lovingly focuses his attention on the One Lord, always dwelling with the Lord.

verse.unicode: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਗਹਣ ਗਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਸਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥

transliteration.english: tin kee gahan gat kahee na jaiee sachai aap savaare ||

en.bdb: His depth and condition cannot be described. The True Lord Himself embellishes him.

verse.unicode: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੇ ਸਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਰੇ ॥੩॥

transliteration.english: bharam bhulaane s manmukh kahe'eeh naa uravaar na paare ||3||

en.bdb: Those who wander around, deluded by doubt, are called manmukhs; they are neither on this side, nor on the other side. ||3||

verse.unicode: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥

transliteration.english: jis no nadhar kare soiee jan paae gur kaa sabadh sam(h)aale ||

en.bdb: That humble being, who is blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace obtains Him, and contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
In the midst of Maya, the Lord's servant is emancipated.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਾਲਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥

transliteration.english: naanak bhaag hovai jis masatak kaaleh maar bidhaare ||4||1||

en.bdb: O Nanak, one who has such destiny inscribed upon his forehead, conquers and destroys death. ||4||1||
